title: Pallatom2 all-atom generative model yields high-affinity de novo protein binders
summary: Biolayer interferometry identified 112 active designs among 210 tested candidates (53.3%), with binders obtained for all ten experimentally evaluated targets. Six targets reached picomolar-scale apparent affinities, including KD 3.96 pM for SC2RBD and 33.8 pM for PD-L1, while TNF-alpha reached 1.166 nM. Interface-guided redesign and partial diffusion improved affinity, and CDR remodeling turned an inactive de novo nanobody into binders with apparent KD of 4.31 and 5.93 nM. This is a preprint with apparent affinities reported in the abstract.
